visual_enhancers.aesthetic: Swiss Brutalist meets Investment Banking with Retro Digital pixel-art motifs.
visual_enhancers.borders: Strict 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) to enforce data grids, tables, and rigid layout structures.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist flat shadows or hard offset shadows (e.g., 2px 2px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)). Avoid soft, diffuse dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-none or rounded-sm to maintain banking rigidity and align with the pixel aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.accents: Use pixelated dot patterns (via CSS radial-gradient or SVG) as subtle background textures for hero sections or empty states.

buttons.style: Medium size (px-6 py-2.5), uppercase text, sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm)
buttons.outline: border border-slate-300 hover:border-slate-800 text-slate-900 bg-transparent transition-colors

cards.teaser: Bento grid layout. Bold typographic hierarchy for EBITDA/Revenue. Prominent sector tags using the brand colors.

tables.style: Strict tabular layout, 1px border-b on rows, font-mono for numeric data, sticky headers.

badges.style: px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-sm

grids_and_layouts.marketplace: Grid columns (1 on mobile, 2/3 on desktop) with generous gap-6. Dedicated Filter sidebar on left.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Strict layout for Deal Engine pipelines and CRM widgets.
grids_and_layouts.data_room: Hierarchical folder structure, dense list view with strict columns (Name, Date, Access Level, Actions).

motion.transitions: Fast, precise, non-bouncy. transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out.
motion.hover: Slight border color darkening or subtle background tint. No massive scaling or floating.
motion.loaders: Pixel-art style loaders or strict progress bars.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on Coral/Blue/Green backgrounds is pure white. Use text-slate-900 on Yellow backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='deal-card-cta').

images.description: Digital agency office - use for seller landing pages or empty dashboard states.
Business meeting handshake - use for LOI success, NDA signatures, or Deal Closed states.
Abstract data graph - use for Data Room / Valuation System backgrounds.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for the Valuation System and EBITDA charts (2D is better for pure data clarity in M&A). Avoid heavy 3D libraries to keep the Investment Banking aesthetic crisp.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the public Marketplace Discovery to allow bento grid freedom.
Use Shadcn UI (heavily customized for crisp edges and specific brand colors) for Dashboards, Data Room, and Deal Engine.
NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Enforce IBM Plex Sans for body/headings and IBM Plex Mono for data/labels.

Ensure the Deal Engine visually represents the pipeline (draft -> published -> NDA -> evaluation -> intent -> shortlist -> exclusivity -> DD -> closed) using a horizontal stepper or dense kanban board layout.
Apply 'data-testid' to all key elements for testing.
universal_guidelines: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React.
Use named exports for components and default exports for pages.
Apply 2-3x more spacing for marketing pages, but use dense layouts for dashboards.
Do not use transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns that overlay text.
